title: SologgerConfig
description: This is the main configuration file for sologger. The location of this file is specified by the `SOLOGGER_APP_CONFIG_LOC` environment variable or as the first argument via the cargo run command.

allWithVotes.description: Set to true to subscribe to all transactions, including simple vote transactions. Otherwise, subscribe to all transactions except for simple vote transactions

commitmentLevel.description: The measure of the network confirmation and stake levels on a particular block.

backfill.description: Optional historical backfill run at startup: replays past transactions of the selected programs via getSignaturesForAddress + getTransaction through the normal pipeline. Requires explicit programs in programsSelector.

fromSlot.description: Only replay transactions at or after this slot

untilSlot.description: Only replay transactions at or before this slot

limit.description: Maximum number of signatures to replay per program

throttleMs.description: Delay between getTransaction calls, to respect RPC rate limits

exitAfter.description: Exit once the backfill finishes instead of continuing into the live tail (post-mortem mode)

backfillTruncated.description: When a transaction's logs arrive truncated ('Log truncated'), refetch the full transaction over HTTP (rpcHttpUrl) and re-parse it.

idls.description: Optional map of program ID to the path of an Anchor IDL JSON file (legacy or 0.30+ spec). Logs from a listed program are enriched: 'Program data:' events are borsh-decoded into decoded_events and custom program error codes are resolved to error_name. Paths are relative to the working directory, like the other config locations.

log4rsConfigLocation.description: The location of the log4rs config file

opentelemetryConfigLocation.description: The location of the opentelemetry config file

rpcHttpUrl.description: The HTTP RPC endpoint used for getTransaction / getSignaturesForAddress calls (truncation backfill and historical backfill). When empty, it is derived from rpcUrl: ws(s):// becomes http(s)://, and port 8900 becomes 8899.

rpcUrl.description: The URL of the RPC endpoint to connect to

source.description: The WebSocket subscription used as the log source. blockSubscribe delivers whole blocks (one notification per block, all transactions) but is not enabled on every RPC provider.

webhookConfigLocation.description: The location of the webhook config file, used by binaries built with the enable_webhook feature. See the WebhookConfig docs in sologger_log_transport for the file's shape (url, format, errorsOnly, programs, instructions, timeoutMs).
